string_mesh — DRIVE kendamaworld op

• Data kinds: none → any (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.string_mesh(p_ball, p_cup, radius: 'float' = 0.0015) (to call the implementation directly, import kendamaworld; kendamaworld.string_mesh(p_ball, p_cup, radius: 'float' = 0.0015); from the registry, opsdrive.get("string_mesh"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

2 点(玉の糸穴 p_ball と皿胴の糸穴 p_cup)を結ぶ細い角柱(4 面 + 両端、8 頂点 12 面、外向き)。断面は 2·radius 角。

両点が一致すると ValueError。
